segments.JON.1.4-5: The LORD sends a great storm while Jonah sleeps
segments.JON.1.6-7: The captain wakes Jonah; the lot falls on Jonah
segments.JON.1.8-10: Jonah tells the sailors he worships the LORD
segments.JON.1.11-13: Jonah tells the sailors to throw him into the sea
segments.JON.1.14-16: The sailors throw Jonah into the sea and worship the LORD
segments.JON.1.17-17: The LORD sends a great fish to swallow Jonah
segments.JON.2.1-2: Jonah prays to the LORD from inside the fish
segments.JON.2.3-4: Jonah feels far from God but looks to the temple
segments.JON.2.5-6: Jonah says the LORD saved his life from the pit
segments.JON.2.7-8: Jonah remembers the LORD, and his prayer reaches God
segments.JON.2.9-10: Jonah praises God, and the fish puts him on dry land
segments.JON.3.1-3: God tells Jonah again to go to Nineveh, and Jonah goes
segments.JON.3.4-5: Jonah warns Nineveh, and the people believe God
segments.JON.3.6-7: The king of Nineveh orders everyone to fast
segments.JON.3.8-9: The king tells people to turn from evil and call to God
segments.JON.3.10-10: God sees the Ninevites turn and does not destroy the city
segments.JON.4.1-3: Jonah is angry and asks the LORD to take his life
segments.JON.4.4-5: Jonah waits east of the city to see what happens
segments.JON.4.6-7: God gives Jonah a vine, then sends a worm to kill it
segments.JON.4.8-9: God sends a hot wind, and Jonah wants to die
segments.JON.4.10-11: The LORD explains why he cares about Nineveh
